title: 第二十章 混元丹诀
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
先前讥笑叶辰的至圣强者，突然发出了凄厉惨嚎，竟然被叶辰临身，一拳击中。

    “是聂婉箩。是我的老婆。是我的爱人。是我，的宝贝。”这是乔能迄今为止说过的最肉麻的话，却是聂婉箩最需要的回答。

    左宗棠写这封信的目的非常明确：只要曾国藩把湘勇练成劲旅，不要说一些满人奈何不了他，就是当今天子，同样也奈何不了他。

    所有人都提把注意力提到最高，十几双眼睛都死死地盯在点唱机三十二寸的显示屏上。

    当日午后，官栈便相继挂出两个条子。一条子上写的是：“宪命湖南团练水师战船局”；一个条子上写的是“益阳民船登记所”。

    车无忧试过了几种方法，苦思冥想一天时间，但是他体内的药力仍然无法得到有效的梳理。因为这些药力本就是潜藏的，要想梳理谈何容易。最后车无忧无奈之下，既然这种修炼方式走不通，那就走另一种极端的修炼。

    可是看人挑水相当的轻松，但是当自己真正尝试的时候，才知道这有多么的艰难。即使观看过，也用心体悟过雪凤鸣的战斗，但是当车无忧一旦动手的时候，却又茫然没有任何头绪了。

    “胡说，谁闹别扭了。”魏国清辩驳道，不过这样的辩驳显然没什么说服力，因为韩彩娟的样子任谁看也不象是高兴的样子。

    “谢师叔”接过灭绝师太递来的玉瓶，张硕躬身道谢，而后看了下玉瓶的属性。

    在这个没有法律道德的地方，人类本身就是商品之一，是可以买卖的，当然，如果对方不愿意，恰巧TETS拥有足够的力量，他们也不介意采取一些必要手段，比如客串一下海盗。

    如今跟同是皇阶的高手战斗，她直接使用了大开大合的战斗方式。
content_en:
The sage and powerful man who had previously ridiculed Ye Chen suddenly let out a miserable howl, and was unexpectedly hit by Ye Chen with a punch.

    "It's Nie Wanluo. It's my wife. It's my lover. It's my baby." This was the most disgusting thing Qiao Neng had ever said so far, but it was the answer Nie Wanluo needed most.

    Zuo Zongtang's purpose in writing this letter is very clear: as long as Zeng Guofan trains Xiang Yong into a powerful force, let alone some Manchus who can't do anything to him, even today, they can't do anything to him.

    Everyone's attention was raised to the highest level, and more than a dozen pairs of eyes were fixed on the 32-inch display screen of the jukebox.

    In the afternoon of that day, two notes were hung up one after another at the official inn. One note said: "Xianming Hunan Regiment Training Division Warship Bureau"; another note said "Yiyang Civilian Ship Registration Office".

    Che Wuyou tried several methods and thought hard for a day, but the power of the medicine in his body still could not be effectively sorted out. Because these medicinal powers are hidden, it is not easy to sort them out. In the end, Che Wuyou had no choice but to decide that since this method of cultivation didn't work, he would resort to another extreme method of cultivation.

    But it is quite easy to watch people carry water, but when you really try it, you realize how difficult it is. Even though he had watched and understood Xue Fengming's battle, once Che Wuyou took action, he was at a loss and had no clue.

    "Nonsense, who is causing trouble?" Wei Guoqing argued, but this argument was obviously unconvincing, because Han Caijuan didn't look happy to anyone.

    "Uncle Xie" took the jade vase handed over by Master Jue. Zhang Shuo bowed and thanked him, and then looked at the properties of the jade vase.

    In this place where there is no law and morality, human beings themselves are one of the commodities and can be bought and sold. Of course, if the other party is unwilling, TETS happens to have enough power, and they don't mind taking some necessary measures, such as appearing as pirates.

    Now she was fighting against a master who was also an emperor, and she directly used the fighting method of opening and closing.
